# nxr

> curl for a Sonatype Nexus raw repository: URL in argv, credentials from `-u` or env, no config file.
> Resumable verified directory transfers, digests, channels, plus server metadata over the service REST API.

Install: `cargo install nexus-raw`, or `npm install @nexus-raw/nxr` under node.
Prebuilt binaries on the releases page: https://github.com/Lipen/nexus-raw/releases

The agent minimum:

- Exit codes: `0` ok, `1` data, `2` misuse, `3` transport.
- Every error prints one `hint:` line on stderr telling the next thing to check.
  The hint carries `server says:` with the short 4xx/5xx body.
- `--json` is machine output.
  Transfers, `rm` and `verify` print one NDJSON event per line and a `summary` event once the transfer stage is reached.
  Per-name failures are listed in the summary and also emitted as `error` objects after it, and a command that fails earlier (an enumeration refusal, a divergence in the diff) prints the `error` object alone.
  `put` and `get -o` print artifact events and then one final object with the byte count and digest.
  `ls` and `doctor` print one object per entry or per check, and `head`, `sha`, `channel`, `point` and `service …` print a single object.
- Credentials: `-u user:pass`, or `NXR_AUTH` (base64 `user:pass`), or `NXR_USERNAME` + `NXR_PASSWORD`.
  Without `-R` there is no config file in play, by design.
- Long URLs: `-R <alias>` names a remote from `~/.config/nxr/config.toml` (`nxr -R releases ls 1.4.0/`).
  The file is read only when the flag names an alias, nothing is picked up implicitly.
- Listing needs an enumeration source: repeatable `--name`, `--names-from FILE`, or `--ls` (search API).
- Commands `service repos|status|repo|assets|eula`: `eula --accept` needs nx-admin.
- A ready-made agent skill lives in the repo at `skills/nxr/SKILL.md`, with `references/recipes.md` and `references/quirks.md`.
  Install it with `scripts/install-skill.sh`.

Intent to command:

| Intent | Command |
|:--|:--|
| which repositories exist? | `nxr service repos <url>` |
| server alive? | `nxr service status <url>` |
| what repo is this URL? | `nxr service repo <url>` |
| what is inside (any format)? | `nxr service assets <repo-url>` |
| server refuses writes | `nxr service eula <url> --accept` |
| raw dir listing | `nxr ls <dir-url>` (`--json` for NDJSON) |
| fetch one file | `nxr get <url> -o <file>` |
| fetch one file through 8 ranges | `nxr get <url> -o <file> --segments 8` |
| fetch one byte span | `nxr get <url> --range 100-199` |
| fetch a directory | `nxr down <dir-url> <dst-dir> --names-from list.txt` |
| clone a whole repository for backup | `nxr clone <repo-url> <dst-dir>` |
| push a directory | `nxr up <dir> <dir-url>` |
| push a subtree | `nxr up <dir> <dir-url> --prefix <dir>/` (only the selected subtrees are scanned) |
| compare local vs remote | `nxr diff <dir> <dir-url> --ls` |
| move a version | `nxr mv <src-url> <dst-url> --ls` |
| copy a version | `nxr mirror <src-url> <dst-url> --ls` |
| delete a version | `nxr rm <dir-url> --names-from list.txt` |
| local sanity check | `nxr verify <dir>` |
| access diagnostics | `nxr doctor <url>` |

Quirks that are not bugs:

- `GET /service/rest/v1/status` returns 200 with an empty body on Nexus 3.79.
- `/v1/repositories` is a trimmed collection (`size`, empty `attributes`) even for admins.
  Full settings live in the admin-only `GET /v1/repositories/{format}/{type}/{name}`.
- Anonymous and authenticated users see different repository lists.
- CE 3.79+: every PUT answers 403 until the EULA is accepted.
- Right after `up`/`put` the search index lags for a few seconds.
  An empty listing is not a lost write.
- A repository filled by an external publisher may be only partially visible to the search API: some subtrees are indexed, others are not.
  When a listing looks short, probe availability by name with `head`/`get`; `service assets` asks the same search and sees the same gap.
- `ls` names the count of hidden markers in a trailing line (`N marker objects hidden`).
  A silent undercount became a visible one.
- `/-/` in paths is the npm-protocol segment, not part of the nxr protocol.
- A raw repository can hold foreign names (spaces, parens, unicode).
  The tree `ls` shows them, and any enumeration that feeds a transfer hides them and names the count (a `warning` event): the `[A-Za-z0-9._-]` alphabet is what nxr can transfer, not a server-side rule.
- npm repositories: inspect via `nxr service assets`.
  Fetch packages with an npm client.
- `-o` must be a real path: nxr writes a sibling `<name>.part` and renames it after the transfer (the resume scheme).
  Omit `-o` to stream to stdout.

## Tutorials

- [Get started](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/get-started/): install, first push and pull in five commands
- [Rust quickstart](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/tutorials/rust/): the library facade, transfer and layout APIs
- [Node quickstart](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/tutorials/node/): the npm package over the same surface
- [Terminal quickstart](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/tutorials/ops/): ops-driven: channels, pointers, a nightly mirror

## How-to

- [Drive it with an agent](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/agents/): the one-page cookbook: intent to command to expected result
- [Install the agent skill](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/skills/): the SKILL.md bundle, the auto-detecting installer and the copy fallback
- [Integrate it](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/integrate/): scripting over NDJSON, exit codes and hints
- [Publish a version](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/publish/): up, markers, channels, the sha-sibling rule
- [Audit a repository](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/audit/): the integrity report: structural findings, --bytes for silent bitrot
- [Keep the newest versions](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/retention/): keep-N retention from ls, channels and rm, no guessing
- [Compare two servers](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/compare/): staging vs prod through mirror --dry-run, the plan is the delta
- [Consume artifacts](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/consume/): down, unpack, digest verification
- [Read from a static host](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/static-host/): the read profile on a host without Nexus: get, segments, names-from, verify, and the 405 refusal to expect
- [Clone a repository](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/clone/): a verified local copy, the update run, the fact cache and the seal
- [Install with Homebrew](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/brew/): the tap in this repository, upgrade and regeneration
- [Use in CI](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/ci/): credentials, caching, the retry contract
- [Run it as a container](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/containers/): the release image, a transfer with docker run, COPY --from into a downstream image
- [Named remotes](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/config/): the -R alias file: one TOML, read only when named
- [Run the demo](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/demo/): a scripted tour: publish, consume, refuse, repair
- [Run the browser sandbox](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/wasm/): nxr compiled to wasm, listing and uploading against a fake or a real Nexus
- [When it breaks](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/how-to/troubleshoot/): symptom to cause to fix, plus server quirks

- [CLI reference](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/cli/): every command, flag and output shape
- [Errors and exit codes](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/errors/): the error taxonomy and every hint
- [Wire protocol](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/protocol/): store shape, markers and forbiddances
- [Wire invariants](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/invariants/): the rules every client must hold
- [The mock server](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/mock/): failure scenarios, Spec composition, seed-dir and config
- [Rust API](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/api/): the `Nxr` facade, events and configuration
- [The TUI](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/tui/): keys, presets and config of the terminal browser
- [The mount](https://lipen.github.io/nexus-raw/reference/mount/): the read-only FUSE view of a repository
